prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. If object is near, take and check it, then perform task and release it, else approach it or scan the area. list of available nodes: <Action ID = GrabObject    /> <Action ID = ReleaseObject    /> <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <Action ID = ScanAreaForObject    /> <Action ID = PerformTask    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <SubTree ID = ProcessObject    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
			DO GrabObject
	ELSE
		DO PerformTask
		DO ReleaseObject
	END
